senses.gloss:
mn. (-चः-चं)
1 A saw.
2 A thorny plant: see करीर.
f. (-चा)
The Ketaki: see the next.
E.
क्र an imitative sound, कच to emit sound, affix अच्.

m. (-दः)
A plant with a strong smelling flower, (Pandanus odoratissimus.)
E.
क्रकच a saw, and छद a leaf; having serrated leaves.

m. (-पाद् or -पात्)
A chameleon, a lizard.
E.
क्रकच a saw, पाद् a foot, saw-footed, or with a final vowel, क्रकचपाद m. (-दः)

f. (-ष्ठी)
A small fish with numerous small spines in the back, (Coius cobojius, HAM.)
E.
क्रकच a saw, and पृष्ठ the back, saw-backed.

m. (-णः)
A kind of partridge, commonly Kayar; also कृकण and क्रकर.

m. (-रः)
1 A sort of partridge, called Kaër, (Perdix sylvatica); also कृकर.
2 A thorny plant, vulgarly Karil: see करीर.
3 A saw.
4 A poor man.
E.
क्र an imitative sound, कर what makes.

m. (-तुः)
1 Sacrifice, offering, worship.
2 An Aśvamedha, the sacrifice.
3 The name of a Muni, one of the seven principal Ṛṣis or saints, the offspring of BRAHMĀ, married to Kriyā, and the father of the 60,000 Bālikhilyas.
4 One of the ten VIŚVADEVAS.
E.
कृञ् to do, क्तु Uṇādi aff.

m. (-दः)
1 A Jina.
2 One skilled in sacrifice.

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
Equal to an Aśvamedha in merit.
E.
क्रतु, and तुल्य equal.

m. (-द्रुक् or -द्रुग्-द्रुट् or -द्रुड्)
An Asura, a demon.
E.
क्रतु sacrifice, and द्रुह who hates, affix क्विप्.

m. (-द्विट्)
A Daitya or demon.
E.
क्रतु a sacrifice, and द्विष who hates.

m. (-सी)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
क्रतु a sacrifice, ध्वसि to destroy, affix णिनि, the destroyer of DAKṢA'S sacrifice: see दक्ष.

m. (-शुः)
A horse, especially such a one as is fit for an Aśvamedha.
E.
क्रत sacrifice, and पशु animal.

m. (-षः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
क्रतु, and पुरुष man or male.

n. (-लं)
The reward of a sacrifice, the object for which it is performed.
E.
क्रतु, and फल fruit.

m. (-भुक्)
A god, a deity.
E.
क्रतु sacrifice, and भुज् who eats.

m. (-जः)
A particular sacrifice, the Rājasūya: one performed by a monarch who has subdued all the princes of the [] word.
E.
क्रतु sacrifice, and राज a king; a royal or preeminent ceremony: see राजसूय.

m. (-यी)
A Brahman who sells to another the possible benefits of a sacrifice which he has performed.
E.
क्रतु, and विक्रयिन् who sells; also क्रतुविक्रायकः

f. (-द्धिः)
Completion of a sacrifice, attainment of the object for which it is performed.
E.
क्रतु, and सिद्धि completion.

m. (-मः)
The Rājasūya sacrifice: see the preceding.
E.
क्रतु, and उत्तम best: the pre-eminent sacrifice.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (क्रथयति-ते and क्राथयति-ते)
To kill, to hurt or injure.
r. 10th cl. (क्रथयति)
To amuse, to delight repeatedly.

n. (-नं)
1 Slaughter, killing.
2 Snoring, stertor.
E.
क्रथ to kill, affix ल्युट्.

n. (-कं)
A white sort of Agallochum: see अगुरु.

r. 1st cl. (क्रदते) or (इ) क्रदि (क्रन्दति)
1 To confound, to confuse.
2 To grieve, to be confused;
also (क्रन्दति)
1 To call, to cry out.
2 To weep, to shed tears: see क्रन्द.

mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ)
Going, who or what goes.
E.
क्रम, and तृच् aff.

r. 1st and 10th cls. generally used with आङ् prefixed, आक्रन्द (आक्रन्दति आक्रन्दयति)
1 To weep, to shed tears.
2 To call continually.

m. (-नः)
A cat.
n. (-नं)
1 Weeping, lamenting, sobbing.
2 Crying out, calling.
3 Mutual daring or defiance, challenging, braving.
E.
क्रदि to cry out, to call, sob, &c. affix ल्युट्; also with क्र affix क्रन्दित.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Wept.
2 Called or cried out.
n. (-तं.)
1 Weeping.
2 Calling.
3 Mutual daring: see the preceding.
E.
क्रन्द to call, क्त aff.

r. 1st cl. (क्रपते)
1 To compassionate, to pity.
2 To go or move: see कृप.

r. 1st cl. (उ) क्रमु (क्रामति क्राम्यति or क्रम्यति)
To go, to walk, to step:
(in the following senses it is optionally deponent): (क्रमते क्रम्यते)
1 To proceed uninterruptedly.
2 To grow or increase.
3 To preserve.
It is also active or deponent according to various prefixes and in various senses, as,
with अति
(अतिक्रामति)
1 To go over or beyond, to leap over.
2 To transgress, to pass beyond the bounds of virtue.
With अनु
(अनुक्रमते)
To proceed regularly or in order.
With अभि
(अभिक्रामति)
1 To overcome, to surpass.
2 To assail.
With अप
(अपक्रमते)
To go away, to depart.
With आङ्,
(आक्रमते)
To rise as the sun, &c.
or (आक्रामति)
To rise, to mount, to overcome.
With उत्,
(उत्क्रामति)
To transgress.
With उप,
(उपक्रामति)
To depart.
(उपक्रमते)
To begin.
With निर्,
(निष्क्रामति)
To go forth.
With पर and आङ्
(पराक्रमति)
To display valour, to surpass or overcome.
With प्र,
(प्रक्रामति)
To depart, to go or approach.
(प्रक्रमते)
To begin.
With परि,
(परिक्रामति)
To wander about, to ramble.
With वि,
(विक्रामति)
1 To overcome.
2 To mount or ascend.
(विक्रमते)
To pace, to proceed by steps, to move with the feet.
With वि and आङ्
(व्याक्रमते)
To transgress.
With सम्,
(संक्रामति)
to remove.

m. (-मः)
1 Going, proceeding.
2 A sacred precept or practice prescribed by the Vedas.
3 Order, method.
4 Power, strength.
5 Overcoming, surpassing, subduing, &c.
6 A foot.
7 Uninterrupted progress.
E.
क्रम to go, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Orderly, methodical.
2 Proceeding, going.
m. (-कः)
A student who goes through a regular course of study, one who proceeds methodically. क्रम to go, affix वुन्.

f. (-ज्या)
(In astronomy,) The sine of a planet's declination.
E.
क्रम going, and ज्या sine.

m. (-णः)
A foot.
n. (-णं)
Going, proceeding.
E.
क्रम to go, affix ल्युट्.

ind.
Gradually, successively, in order.
E.
क्रम, and तस् aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Going, proceeding.
E.
क्रम to go, शानच् aff.

m. (-गः)
Successive or methodical practice.
E.
क्रम, and योग union.

ind.
1 Gradually, by degrees.
2 Regularly, seriatim.
E.
क्रम, and शसि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Descended to or inherited lineally, what comes from one's ancestors in regular succession.
2 Arrived in due course or succession.
E.
क्रम, and आगत come.

n. (-त्वं)
Hereditary succession or possession.
E.
त्व added to the preceding.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Proceeding in regular order.
2 Descended lineally, (estate, &c.)
E.
क्रम order, and आयात come, obtained.

m. (-मिः)
A worm: see क्रिमि.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Going, who or what goes, &c.
E.
क्रम to go, तृच् affix, with इट augment.

m. (-मुः)
The betel nut tree, (Areca faufel or catechu); also क्रमुक्.

m. (-कः)
1 The areca or betel nut, (Areca faufel or catechu.)
2 A kind of tree, a red sort of Lodh: see लाघ्र.
3 A kind of fragrant grass: see भद्रमुस्तक.
4 The mulberry tree, (Morus Indica.)
5 The fruit of the cotton tree.
f. (-की)
The areca tree.
E.
क्रम to go, उक aff.

n. (-लं)
The areca nut.
E.
क्रमुक, and फल fruit.

m. (-लः)
A camel: see the next.

m. (-कः)
A camel.
E.
क्रम to go, एलप Uṇādi affix, and कन् added; or क्रम order, इल to go, क affix, and कन् added.

m. (-गः)
An ox.
E.
क्रम a foot, उद्वेग who goes.

m. (यः)
Buying, purchase.
E.
क्री to buy, अच् aff.

mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं)
Purchasable.
E.
क्री to buy, यत् affix, deriv. irr.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Bought, purchased.
E.
क्रय, and क्रीत bought.

n. (-ख्यं)
Deed of sale, conveyance, &c.
E.
क्रय, and लेख्य writing.

m. (-यः)
Trade, traffic, buying and selling.
E.
क्रय purchase, विक्रय sale.

m. (-यः)
Rescission of sale, a title of civil judicature.
E.
क्रयविक्रय, and अनुशय doubt.

m. (-कः)
A trader or merchant, a dealer.
E.
क्रय buying, विक्रय sale, and ठन् aff.

m. (-र्षः)
The coping of a wall.

m. (-हः)
A market, a fair.
E.
क्रय purchase, and रुह to rise, आङ् prefix, and घञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A trader, a dealer.
2 A purchaser, a buyer.
E.
क्री to buy, Uṇādi affix इकन्.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
A buyer or purchaser.
E.
क्री to buy, इनि aff.

n. (-व्यं)
1 Flesh.
2 Raw flesh.
E.
कृप to be able, यत् affix, and प changed to ब; the latter becomes dental before य.

m. (-नः)
A deer.
E.
क्रव्य flesh, and घातन killing for its flesh.

mfn. (-भुक्)
Carnivorous.
m. (-भुक्)
A Rākṣasa.
E.
क्रव्य, भुज who eats.

m. or mfn. (-व्याद् or -व्यात्)
1 An imp or goblin, a Rākṣasa.
2 A flesh-eater.
3 A beast of prey, a carnivorous animal.
E.
क्रव्य flesh, अद् to eat, विद् affix, or with अण् affix, क्रव्याद.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
An eater of flesh or meat, carnivorous.
m. (-दः)
1 A goblin, a Rākṣasa.
2 A lion.
3 A hawk.
4 Funeral fire.
E.
see the preceding.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
Carnivorous.
m. (-शी)
A demon, an anthropophagus.
E.
क्रव्य, and अशिन् who eats.

m. (-कः)
A sawyer.
E.
क्रकच्, and ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
1 Overcome, surpassed.
2 Attacking, invading, gone to or against.
3 Spread, extended.
4 Going, going over or across.
m. (-न्तः)
1 A horse.
2 (In astronomy,) Declination.
n. (-न्तं)
An astrological element, the conjunction of any planet with the moon.
E.
क्रम to go, affix क्त.

f. (-न्तिः)
1 Going, proceeding.
2 Overcoming, surpassing.
3 The sun's course on the globe, the ecliptic.
4 Declination of a planet.
E.
क्रम to go, affix क्तिन्.

m. (-क्षः)
The ecliptic.
E.
क्रान्ति, and कक्ष girdle.

f. (-ज्या)
Sine of the declination.
E.
क्रान्ति, and ज्या sine.

m. (-तः)
The nodes of the ecliptic, or the equinoctial points.
E.
क्रान्ति, and पात going.

f. (-तिः)
Motion of the nodes of the ecliptic, precession of the equinox.
E.
क्रान्तिपात, and गति going.

m. (-गः)
Declination of a point of the ecliptic.
E.
क्रान्ति, and भाग division.

n. (-लं)
The ecliptic.
E.
क्रान्ति, and मण्डल circle.

m. (-यः)
The space within the tropics.
E.
क्रान्ति, and वलय bracelet.

m. (-न्तुः)
A bird in general.
E.
क्रम to go, वुन् Uṇādi affix, and the pen. made long.

mfn. (-मन्-मन्ती-मत्)
1 Going, proceeding over or through.
E.
क्रम to go, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 A buyer or purchaser.
2 A dealer, a trader. क्री to buy, ण्वुल् aff.
